component.name: RustDiff
component.summary: Semantic JSON, XML and SQL comparator
Comparador semántico de JSON, XML y SQL

description.p: RustDiff is a desktop application that compares two JSON, XML or SQL documents by their structure — keys, array indices, XML nodes and attributes, SQL statements — instead of by raw text lines, and highlights the differences in a clear, visual way. The diff engine is written in Rust; the interface is a Tauri app with a web-based UI.

RustDiff es una aplicación de escritorio que compara dos documentos JSON, XML o SQL por su estructura — claves, índices de arreglos, nodos y atributos XML, sentencias SQL — en lugar de línea por línea, y resalta sus diferencias de forma clara y visual. El motor de diff está escrito en Rust; la interfaz es una app Tauri con UI web.
Main features:

ul.li: Semantic diff for JSON (key by key), XML (nodes, attributes and text) and SQL (statement by statement), with a line-by-line fallback for plain text.
Split editor with syntax highlighting, automatic pretty-print and in-editor search.
Inline and full-line highlighting for added, removed and changed items.
Filterable table of differences, clickable to jump to the exact location.
Graph view of JSON and XML documents with pan, zoom and node search.
Light and dark themes that follow the system, and adjustable text size.
Export to plain text or styled HTML.
Session history backed by SQLite, searchable, with per-entry and bulk deletion.

description.p: A feature release: the editors now recognise JSON that arrives with the quotes escaped and offer to unescape it.

ul.li: Detects JSON with escaped quotes and offers to unescape it with one click; valid documents are never touched and the document's whitespace is preserved.
Adds CONTRIBUTING.md and a canary branch: pull requests target canary and main only holds released code.
The CI runs on canary as well.
Fixes the pnpm bindings script, which pointed at a test target that no longer exists.

description.p: Desktop-integration and editor-highlight fixes.

ul.li: The window announces the application id, so the desktop shows its real icon and groups it with its launcher.
Editor highlighting is anchored to the diff paths, so a modified element is no longer painted as a whole added block when the other document appends a copy of it.
The focused editor's ring closes on all four sides.

description.p: Packaging fix: the application icon now ships as a PNG set alongside the SVG, because the Flatpak builder runtime decodes icons through a pipeline that cannot read the SVG.

The first stable release: a full rewrite of the interface on a modern stack. The diff engine, the parsers, the history database and the settings file are the same code as in 0.4.0, so upgrading needs no migration and your history and preferences carry over.

ul.li: A Tauri v2 shell in Rust with a React 19 and TypeScript interface, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui components on Radix, and the self-hosted Geist and Geist Mono fonts.
CodeMirror 6 editors with syntax highlighting, line and character-level diff highlighting, pretty-print and search.
A design system built on OKLCH tokens, with light and dark themes (dark by default, or follow the system) and WCAG AA contrast checked by tests.
The graph view is drawn on a 2D canvas over a layout computed in Rust, with pan, zoom, zoom-to-fit, node search and node inspection.
The language switches between English and Spanish on the spot, without a restart.
Typed communication between the interface and the Rust core: the interface never touches the filesystem.
History, filters, export to .txt and .html, keyboard shortcuts and the text size setting work as before.
Fixed a crash at launch on NVIDIA graphics under Wayland.
Removed the "Open History" desktop action, which never worked.
RustDiff is no longer published on crates.io, and the Homebrew source formula is retired in favour of the prebuilt rustdiff-app cask.

description.p: A tidier header bar and a collapsible differences panel.

ul.li: The differences panel can now be hidden and brought back with a header bar button or Ctrl+D, giving the editors the full window height. Opening the graph view hides it automatically and closing the graph restores it.
Secondary header bar actions (differences, graph, history, format) are now icon buttons with tooltips and accessible labels, so the header stays compact on narrow windows.
Fixed symbolic icons that rendered as outlines invisible on dark themes: the bundled fallbacks are now fill-based, which is what GTK recolors.
Every icon the app uses now ships a bundled fallback, so no packaging channel can show a broken-image placeholder when the desktop icon theme lacks a name.
The Debian/APT package now ships the bundled SQL language definition, restoring SQL syntax highlighting for .deb installs.

description.p: Fixes broken icons in the graph view.

ul.li: The graph view toggle, its empty state and the "zoom to fit" button could show up as a generic broken-image icon on themes that don't ship network-workgroup-symbolic or zoom-fit-best-symbolic (notably the Homebrew Adwaita bundled into the macOS build). RustDiff now ships its own fallback icons for both names.
Documented that the .deb/APT packages require Ubuntu 24.04+ or an equivalent recent Debian (libadwaita >= 1.5, GTK4 >= 4.12); older systems should use the Flatpak package instead.

description.p: Fixes the macOS installer.

ul.li: Fixed a packaging bug that made the macOS DMG/Homebrew cask crash on launch with "Library not loaded: @rpath/libsharpyuv.0.dylib". The 0.3.1 macOS build was affected; other channels (Linux, Flathub, APT, crates.io) were not.

description.p: Maintenance release.

ul.li: Fixed a clippy lint failure in the history sidebar that was blocking CI.

description.p: New native graph view for exploring JSON and XML documents.

ul.li: Graph view (Ctrl+G): visualize the left document as an interactive node graph, side by side with the editor, in the style of JSON Crack — fully local, no network or webview involved.
Pan, zoom (Ctrl+scroll or toolbar buttons), zoom-to-fit, node search, and click-to-inspect a node's full contents.
Updates live as you type, alongside the existing diff comparison workflow.

description.p: Adjustable UI text size and broader platform coverage.

ul.li: New "Text Size" option in the main menu: zoom the whole UI in/out with Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Minus and reset with Ctrl+0; the scale persists across sessions.
Debian/APT repository now ships arm64 packages alongside amd64.
macOS: self-contained DMG installers (Apple Silicon and Intel) via the new rustdiff-app Homebrew cask.

description.p: Plain text comparison and interactive keyboard shortcuts.

ul.li: Plain text diffing: documents without JSON/XML/SQL structure are now compared line by line, with character-level highlighting of what changed.
Character-level inline highlighting of changed values in the results table and editors.
New keyboard shortcuts dialog (Ctrl+?), reachable from the menu, the welcome screen and the status bar hint.
Redesigned minimal welcome screen showing the app flow; the status bar now stays anchored to the bottom.

description.p: RustDiff can now be installed on macOS via Homebrew.

ul.li: New Homebrew tap (jereok91/rustdiff) with automated formula updates on each release.

description.p: Open files directly from the command line or your file manager.

ul.li: CLI and "Open with RustDiff": one file loads the editor, two files start a comparison automatically.
JSON, XML and SQL file associations in the desktop entry.
Refreshed application icon.
Fixed syntax highlighting initialization (shared language manager).

description.p: Fixed Flatpak build configuration and offline compilation support. Added SQL syntax highlighting support for source editors.
New user experience: welcome screen, in-editor search, history pagination, and a guided comparison flow.

ul.li: Welcome screen: choose between opening a document, starting a new comparison, or viewing history.
Single-editor startup: only the left editor is shown initially; "Enable comparison" reveals the right panel.
Ctrl+F search: find text inside the left or right editor with Next/Prev navigation and wrap-around.
History pagination: shows the last 3 sessions by default with a "Load more" button and a search field.
Exit dialog: prompts to save to history, export as .txt/.html, or close without saving when unsaved content exists.
Improved layout: larger editor area and a more compact diff panel at the bottom.

description.p: Release 0.1.6 aligns the published version across Cargo, Flatpak, and Debian packaging.
Internationalization: the UI now ships in English by default and switches to Spanish automatically on Spanish systems.

ul.li: Bilingual UI powered by rust-i18n; English is the default and fallback.
New primary menu in the header bar with a Language picker (Auto / English / Español). The selection is stored in ~/.config/rustdiff/settings.json.
Format and Export entries moved into the primary menu; the Format button stays in the header for quick access. Keyboard shortcuts appear next to each menu item.

description.p: Packaging milestone: the application is now ready to ship as a Flatpak on Flathub.

ul.li: Added AppStream metainfo and Flatpak manifest.
Renamed the desktop file and icon to the reverse-DNS AppID as Flathub requires.
Cargo dependencies are now vendored via cargo-sources.json so offline builds work.

description.p: User interface polish and history management.

ul.li: New GitHub-inspired diff color palette that adapts to light and dark themes.
Ctrl + mouse wheel now zooms both editors simultaneously.
Session history can be deleted one by one or cleared entirely.

description.p: macOS build support and minor fixes.
First public release.
